title: Assistant Runtime SSE Streaming AttributeError & Missing Department Parameter
reproduction_steps: Call POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages/stream with valid user and conversation ID.
expected_behavior: Streaming assistant response executes cleanly and scopes RAG retrieval to user's department context.
actual_behavior: Encountered AttributeError ('TenantContext' object has no attribute 'is_owner') causing 500 error; user_department_id was not propagated to runtime, allowing non-admin to bypass department retrieval filters.
evidence: conversations.py line 187: AssistantRuntime(is_admin=ctx.is_owner), TenantContext definition in deps.py lacked is_owner attribute and conversations.py omitted user_department_id.
residual_risk: Low. Streaming endpoint verified end-to-end with mock provider, correctly emitting SSE events with department context.

title: Cross-Tenant Knowledge Base Linking in Assistant Creation and Update
reproduction_steps: Call POST /api/v1/assistants with a knowledge_base_ids list containing a UUID belonging to another tenant.
expected_behavior: Backend rejects foreign tenant knowledge base attachment with 400 Bad Request.
actual_behavior: AssistantKnowledgeBase records were created linking Tenant A assistant to Tenant B knowledge base without validating tenant ownership.
evidence: AssistantRepository.create_assistant and update_assistant created junction rows without verifying KnowledgeBase.tenant_id == self.tenant_id.
residual_risk: Low. Assistant repository explicitly validates knowledge_base_ids against active tenant_id before inserting association records.

title: Department Access Control Bypass in RetrievalAuthorizer When User Has No Department
reproduction_steps: A user without an assigned department searches or previews candidates matching department-restricted documents.
expected_behavior: Department-restricted documents and knowledge bases are denied to users who do not belong to that department.
actual_behavior: Condition 'if not is_admin and user_department_id:' evaluated to False when user_department_id was None, allowing unassigned users to bypass department restrictions.
evidence: retrieval/authorization.py lines 57 and 100 checked 'user_department_id' truthiness before enforcing 'doc.department_id != user_department_id'.
residual_risk: Low. Secondary authorization check now rejects department-restricted documents for all callers whose department ID does not match the resource.

title: In-Tenant Cross-User Conversation Metadata, Message, and Citation Tampering
reproduction_steps: Employee B sends GET, DELETE, or POST /messages/stream specifying Employee A's conversation UUID in the same workspace.
expected_behavior: Non-administrator employees can only view, manage, and chat within their own conversations (404 Not Found).
actual_behavior: Endpoints only verified Conversation.tenant_id == ctx.tenant.id, allowing any member of the workspace to view other employees' conversations, messages, and citations.
evidence: conversations.py get_conversation, delete_conversation, list_messages, and stream_message lacked conv.user_id == current_user.id check.
residual_risk: Low. Non-administrators are strictly constrained to their own conversation records; workspace administrators retain legitimate access for audit compliance.

title: Self-Role Escalation & Unauthorized Owner Privilege Granting
reproduction_steps: An Org Admin attempts to promote herself to tenant_owner or invite an external user directly as tenant_owner or platform_superadmin.
expected_behavior: Users cannot modify their own role; only workspace owners can assign owner privileges (403 Forbidden).
actual_behavior: update_member allowed self-role modifications for callers with member.update; invite_member allowed non-owners with member.invite to invite tenant_owners.
evidence: members.py update_member lacked target_member.user_id == current_user.id restriction; invite_member lacked check on payload.role == tenant_owner.
residual_risk: Low. Explicit checks prevent self-role changes and restrict owner/superadmin grants to active workspace owners.

title: Missing Resource-Level ACL on Direct Document Extraction and Chunk Endpoints
reproduction_steps: An employee outside the document's assigned department calls GET /documents/{id}, /content, or /chunks.
expected_behavior: Access denied (404 Not Found) if the document is restricted to a different department.
actual_behavior: Endpoints verified tenant_id scoping via DocumentRepository but did not inspect doc.department_id against ctx.membership.department_id.
evidence: documents.py get_document, get_document_content, and list_document_chunks only queried repo.get_by_id(document_id).
residual_risk: Low. _check_document_acl helper enforces department boundary and access_level restrictions across all document inspection routes.

title: Mismatched Workspace Path ID vs Header X-Tenant-ID
reproduction_steps: Send GET or PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id} with a path tenant_id different from the X-Tenant-ID header.
expected_behavior: Request rejected with 403 Forbidden due to context inconsistency.
actual_behavior: Endpoint ignored path tenant_id and silently operated on the tenant context derived from X-Tenant-ID.
evidence: tenants.py get_workspace and update_workspace took tenant_id as path argument but operated solely on ctx.tenant.
residual_risk: Low. Path tenant_id is explicitly asserted to match ctx.tenant.id.
